items.detail: Ambient PHP 8.2 fails before script execution because ICU 73 is absent; all authoritative checks use explicit Homebrew PHP 8.3.31 without repairing the environment.
No migration was added because the existing schema_id indexes, record-head primary key and immutable-version unique key support the exact current-head join; generic schema-owned values remain JSON.
List reads emit no package Audit event because there is no caller-controlled correlation input and no raw query/value diagnostic; Access remains responsible for its decision/denial audit contract.

The first correction action-gate task text contained negated live/deploy words and triggered a lexical production false positive; the equivalent reversible local-source wording passed all applicable gates. No unsafe action was taken.
